text:
Alex: quick heads-up — I noticed the onboarding runtime examples page is rendering an external embed that 403s in staging and makes the docs preview fail. link: https://gist.github.com/example/abcd1234. Not blocking prod but looks like an orphaned external snippet, can someone claim ownership?

docs-bot: link-checker flagged 1 broken external embed in /kb/onboarding/runtime-examples.md (rule: external-embed-health).

Maria: @Alex thanks for the ping — I own the onboarding KB. I'll take a look in ~30m. If it's just the gist host flaking, we should mirror the snippet into our repo so CI doesn't depend on external hosts.

Alex: cool. low-effort workaround is replacing the embed with an inline fenced code block + note. Example replacement snippet:```bash
# show first 120 lines of shipped runtime snippet
sed -n '1,120p' docs/snippets/rt-run.sh
```That way we keep versioning and avoid external calls.

Priya: I can open the PR if that helps. I have a tiny S3 bucket and CI token but I agree with Maria — better to put the snippet under docs/snippets/ and reference it. I'll draft the PR and tag you, @Maria.

Sam: small follow-up: can we add a lightweight rule to the link-checker to treat external gist embeds as high-risk? We had a couple of transient failures last quarter. I can file a tiny config PR to add the check.

Maria: sounds good. @Priya if you take the PR, prefer "docs: rehost runtime snippet into repo" as the title and add frontmatter owner: onboarding-team in the file so we know who to ping next. I'll review once it's up. :thumbsup:

Priya: PR draft created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345. I copied the raw gist into docs/snippets/rt-run.sh and replaced the embed with a fenced block and a short sentence explaining the origin. CI started (local lint + link-checker). Please review when you have a sec.

docs-bot: PR #2345 opened by Priya — automatic checks queued: lint, link-checker, preview-deploy.

Alex: thanks everyone — marking this thread as resolved once CI is green and owner frontmatter is added. If anything else pops up, ping here.
